thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager alert fired: prom_scrape_target_unavailable (severity: P2). Affected job=service-metrics-exporter, region=us-west-2. Auto-escalation in 5m if unacknowledged.

sasha: seeing the PD page. prom shows scrape target down for ~6m. no obvious deploys. can someone check exporter pod?

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: Alert acknowledged by sasha.

mike: poking the exporter. `kubectl -n monitoring get pods -l app=service-exporter` shows one pod CrashLoopBackOff and another running. logs show `dial tcp 10.2.34.56:9100: connect: connection refused`.

tera: that IP is the app instance. maybe health probe flapped after the recent rolling restart. can you curl the endpoint from the node?

mike: on host jumpbox: `curl -sS http://10.2.34.56:9100/metrics --max-time 2` -> connection refused. service process not listening.

sasha: is this causing downstream log ingest backlog too? I see increased log queue lag in the dashboard. might be correlated.

alex (support): customer-ops flagged elevated error rates for downstream feature X in us-west-2 ~10m ago. potentially impacted customers: a few enterprise tenants.

tera: plan: 1) restart app on the node (systemd container) 2) temporarily remove exporter scrape target from prometheus via service-discovery override to stop noisy alerts 3) check kafka consumer lag. anyone object?

mike: doing 1) now — `ssh node-12 sudo systemctl restart service-app`

mike: restart returned quickly. `ss -ltnp | grep 9100` still not showing. checking system logs.

mike: app process logs show rapid OOMs from a telemetry thread after JVM got a bad GC pause. rolling back latest config could be needed.

tera: can we bounce exporter container only? i prefer a quick restart of exporter sidecar so scrapes resume for healthy nodes.

sasha: go ahead with exporter restart. if app is OOMing we shouldn't mask the root cause long-term. but we need metrics back for triage and customer comms.

mike: restarted exporter sidecar on node-12, and triggered a force-scrape via Prometheus UI. scraping back for that target, metrics are flowing.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Alert resolved (prom_scrape_target_unavailable) — condition cleared after target returned.

tera: kafka consumer lag is still elevated for the logs topic; backfill started. current lag ~120k msgs, ingestion throughput steady but below target due to batching.

alex (support): I've opened a customer incident note for affected tenants and informed them we're investigating root cause and will follow up with timeline.

sasha: good. immediate mitigation done. next steps: 1) confirm app OOM cause and rollback config (owner: mike) 2) run a controlled restart across the cluster to flush exporters if needed (owner: tera) 3) run postmortem and customer impact summary (owner: alex).

mike: will revert the telemetry change and build a canary deploy for the fix.

tera: i'll schedule a maintenance window for exporter restarts if we see another node flake.

alex (support): tagging account managers. will draft the impact summary once we have duration and affected tenant list.

sasha: if anyone sees repeat spikes ping here. thanks all. :thumbsup:

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: Incident closed by sasha.
